points.why: It handles the event well (hotfix, user outreach, rating tracking) and adds a prevention section, but never says that deadline pressure tends to stop the analysis at the event level.
It checks review themes for this release only and never asks whether ratings or login failures dipped after earlier releases.

It targets release-process structure with staged rollouts, checklist items and alerting, but as ready-made fixes rather than a question about why login regressions ship, and it raises no mental-model or belief question.

pitfalls.why: The plan goes beyond the hotfix and apology to include monitoring, review recovery, prevention and a post-mortem.

notes: The answer commits to specific prevention measures before the post-mortem has run, which risks fixing symptoms without understanding the cause.
